card.name: Partway through drug and label words
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle or start of a longer word in drug labels, such as the AK in LUMAKRAS, the K in KIMYRSA, pen in penicillin, or cut in cutaneous. Also fires on a digit inside a number and on a few linking words.

modes.label: Inside brand and drug names
modes.description: A piece of a brand or drug name where more letters must follow to finish the word.
modes.example: Resume LUM<<AK>>RAS at the next lower dose level

modes.label: Start of medical terms
modes.description: The first piece of a longer medical word such as penicillin or cutaneous.
modes.example: a history of<< pen>>icillin hypersensitivity who have experienced severe

modes.label: Digits and short connectors
modes.description: A digit inside a volume number or a short linking word in a list.

card.plain: It lights up when a long drug or medical word is only half written and the rest is still to come.
